aim: Inspect an existing interpreted SAE source for machine-readable identity, explanation and activation-evidence availability, without assuming those imply a correct or causal semantic feature.
fixed_provider: Neuronpedia public GET; no generation, no inference and no paid API

candidate.publishers_source_terms: Neuronpedia 2025 privacy and terms; exported annotations have no independently established universal redistribution or model-training license

outcome_rules: Valid JSON with matching modelId/sourceId/index and at least one metadata explanation is EXPLANATION_CANDIDATE_ONLY; never SEMANTIC_PASS.
Absent, inconsistent or inaccessible API material is INSUFFICIENT_API_EVIDENCE. Do not infer absence of feature meanings.
Machine-readable activations or published scores are availability signals, not independent causal or behavioral validation.
Do not copy label text or copyrighted activation snippets into repo or use any auto-interp outputs as weight edits/training data.
Reject source identity drift, oversized responses, invalid JSON and malformed scores; do not accept as transplant-ready.
negative_controls: score/activation availability without source intervention proof
reserved_exclusions: actual donor SAE weights or activations in this gate
